lg_Say_n11001: The Sakura Plains lie shrouded in darkness. Only the strongest ninja can survive this tough challenge.
lg_Say_n11002: To prove your own Strength, go to the arena, even with a few wounds. You will find a real fight there.
lg_Say_n11003: Mythical artifacts of war are forged in this furnace! If you can dream it, I can make it!
lg_Say_n11004: Need gems to make your equipment more beautiful? Need hidden weapons to improve your combat ability? Or food and potions? We have them all.
lg_Say_n11005: Don't miss our collection of weapons and armor. A variety of equipment is available at the best prices.
lg_Say_n11006: Powerful ninja can use other ninja's services free of charge! Want to take on a disciple? You've come to the right person!
lg_Say_n11012: Pets are your most reliable companions in battle. To let them grow stronger, leave them in the pet stable. Only there will they receive the best care!
lg_Say_n11013: It's no good to stay on standby all the time. Take a look when you're free, you may find some interesting jobs to choose from!
lg_Say_n11014: You can buy high-grade equipment with attributes here using Stone. Want to try your luck?
lg_Say_n11017: It is said the Five Kage are holding a meeting right after the tailed beast raid. Do you want to take a look?
lg_Say_n17001: The spirits of ancient heroes are under the rule of demons. Can you defeat the servants and the emperor to save the manipulated heroic spirits?
lg_Say_n21001: Intelligence is very important for completing ninja missions.

lg_Say_n26001: To be an excellent ninja, you need strong martial arts, discipline and teamwork to complete missions perfectly.
lg_Say_n26002: Angel City is a peaceful place - a blessing in itself.
lg_Say_n26003: The rare edible ingredients that grow on the plains are nature's gift to humankind. They must not be trampled carelessly.
lg_Say_n26004: To portray world events through artistic expression is our way of life.
lg_Say_n26005: Croakk! Don't underestimate our toads. Only the talented can fight alongside us.
lg_Say_n26006: Choosing materials is an important task. A wrong decision can lead to terrible consequences.
lg_Say_n26007: Stay alert, and don't leave any suspicious entity unchecked.
lg_Say_n26008: A terrifying dark aura covers the whole land. We must destroy its source.
lg_Say_n26009: If monsters and humans could live in harmony, the world would be a much better place.
lg_Say_n26010: Those residents of Angel City get on my nerves. I must teach them a lesson if I ever get the chance.
lg_Say_n26011: With the presence of demons, herb gathering in the area has been whittled down to almost nothing. We won't have enough medicine to treat people at this rate.
lg_Say_n26012: Only through hard training can one become stronger.
lg_Say_n26013:
Child, you can use rings of different quality to redeem a Lover Ring into a high-level appraised one here. After that, the number of ring attributes will be the same, but the type and effect of the attributes will be better!
But please note that the ring's enchantment attributes and embedded gems will be removed!

Tips: Click a monster in the Monster List to show the action menu, then click Attack/Combo to open the current Combo info, and click [Finish Now] to finish the Combos currently in progress.
lg_TaskDes_58009:
Claim a quest reward.

Tips: Go to the Fire Village or Angel City, enter the quest reward area and talk to Rewards to open the Claim Quest Reward view. Then, from your current quest rewards, pick a quest and click [Claim the Reward] in the quest details zone to receive the quest reward of your choice.
lg_TaskDes_58010: Go to<font color='#00b034'> Demon City </font>and talk to the<font color='#00b034'> Demon City Guard </font>to investigate the trail of the<font color='#00b034'> Decadent Ninja</font>.
lg_TaskDes_58011:
Add a friend.
1. Click to open the guide button friends view. 2. Click the add friend icon, and enter the friend name you want to add.
lg_TaskDes_58012:
In the game, the Item Mall sells items.

Tips: Click [ Item Mall ] on the guide bar to open the interface, then browse and buy some items.
In the Mall,many items can be bought with Gold or Gift Coupon, while some items can only be bought with Gold.
lg_TaskDes_58013:
Click the jar icon at the top right, enter the jar shop and smash the jar 10 times.

Tips: Use Honor or Gold to smash more. You can earn Honor from Arena challengesor by accumulating quest reward points; you can also use [Multiple] for jar smashing.
lg_TaskDes_58017:
Raise your level to learn 6 skills and equip them on the skill panel, so that the whole skill panel is filled with skills.

Tips: Defeat monsters in outer zones, auto-battle in the hall, take Arena challenges, take on Las Noches challenges and join other events to earn Exp and raise your level.
lg_TaskDes_59211:
Win in the Arena and raise your Rank to Chunin I .

Tips: Go to the Arena and win duels to raise your Score . Once your score passes the promotion requirement, defeat the Fortune Cat that appears after you win a fight to promote your Rank .
lg_TaskDes_59212:

Tips: Go to the Arena and win duels to raise your Score . Once your score passes the promotion requirement, defeat the Fortune Cat that appears after you win a fight to promote your Rank .
lg_TaskDes_59213:
Win in the Arena and raise your rank to Chunin I .

Tips: Go to the Arena and win duels to raise your score . Once your score passes the promotion requirement, defeat the Fortune Cat that appears after you win a fight to promote your rank .

lg_TaskTalk100010:
Now that you have the basic mindset of a ninja of the world, it's time to test your ability.
Now go to the Smelting Mountains and kill Sunflowers to begin your journey. We can't go on like this. Do you want to catch Sunflowers?
lg_TaskTalk100011: Good, congratulations on passing the trial. You are not a qualified ninja yet.
lg_TaskTalk100020: Becoming a ninja is not easy. You need to train and take part in keeping the village at peace. Go and meet the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>now.
lg_TaskTalk100021: Protecting the village and the travelers passing through is the mission of the village guard.
lg_TaskTalk100030: Even though we sent people, the<font color='#00b034'> Sunflower </font>calamity continues in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>. The<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>outpost has asked the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>for help. Go now and help keep the peace in the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100031: Are you one of those sent by the guards? I've been waiting for you for a while.
lg_TaskTalk100040: <font color='#00b034'>Stinger Bees </font>are the hardest to deal with. So many people have been stung already, and to fight them we need to get their stingers. Help me collect some<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100041: Thank you for getting the<font color='#00b034'> Venom Stingers</font>. Now I can treat the many suffering travelers.
lg_TaskTalk100050: Thanks to the efforts of the guards, the<font color='#00b034'> Stinger Bees </font>no longer pose a threat to travelers. Return to the village and give the good news to the<font color='#00b034'> Jounin</font>!
lg_TaskTalk100051: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>clearly didn't pick the wrong person. Your performance on your first quest was excellent, keep working hard.
lg_TaskTalk100060:
With the crisis over, the Village Elder has decided to hold a banquet to celebrate.
Speaking of banquets, we can't leave out sushi, the finest delicacy in all of the Sakura Plains. Just thinking about it makes my mouth water. But for unknown reasons, the Sushi Monsters have stopped producing sushi. Woe to us if we have to live without sushi!
You must find the Sushi Monsters in the Smelting Mountains and get delicious sushi from them for the banquet. This is an important quest, and I trust you won't let me down.
lg_TaskTalk100061: Ahhh! Here it is! The luxurious<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>! Just its aroma is enough to make a grown man cry tears of joy! To taste such a heavenly delicacy, the villagers will be delighted.
lg_TaskTalk100070: You got the<font color='#00b034'> Wasabi Sushi Roll</font>. Now tell the villagers to join the banquet, the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>has been waiting in the hall.
lg_TaskTalk100071: The villagers have arrived, it's time to have fun at the celebration.
lg_TaskTalk100080:
A series of disturbances has occurred in the Smelting Mountains recently, and it turns out it's not only in the Smelting Mountains. Many disturbances have also happened in the Sakura Plains. All of them are connected to one another.
To confirm the truth, I sent a Genin to investigate in each area. The time to report has come, but the Genin still hasn't arrived. Perhaps he ran into trouble on the road.
Now I need to send an envoy to the Smelting Mountains to investigate, and the Jounin recommended you. This quest is very important, you must give it your best effort.
lg_TaskTalk100081: You're finally here, I need your help!
lg_TaskTalk100090:
After I gathered information, I was attacked on the way home by a group calling themselves the Scarlet gang. So I had to hide here.
Only by wiping out these bandits can we return to the village safely.
lg_TaskTalk100091: The bandit group seems to be taking instructions from someone else to chase me this far. Good riddance.
lg_TaskTalk100100:
You, sent by the Village Elder, must be the scout. Because I was ambushed by bandits, to keep the information from falling into their hands, I let my clever ninja dog escape with it.
Find the ninja dog, and you will have the information.
lg_TaskTalk100101: So my master asked you to help me, it looks like the bandits have been dealt with.
lg_TaskTalk100110: Woof! Woof! So my master sent you to get the information from me. Clever<font color='#00b034'> Pakkun </font>never loses anything important.
lg_TaskTalk100111: So the<font color='#00b034'> Genin </font>was kidnapped by bandits. Thanks to you coming in time, we managed to get the<font color='#00b034'> Recon Scroll</font>.
lg_TaskTalk100120:
It turns out someone is coordinating all these events behind the scenes. The Genin even mentioned that the demons in the Smelting Mountains may be uniting to attack the village.
To prevent this, I have decided to send an elite platoon of guards to hold back the demons. You have proven your performance to be excellent, so you must join this quest.
lg_TaskTalk100121: This attack will surely teach the demons a lesson. At least, they won't be able to retaliate for a while.
lg_TaskTalk100130: I don't know where<font color='#00b034'> Pakkun </font>has run off to now, can you help me find him?
lg_TaskTalk100131: <font color='#00b034'>Pakkun </font>found a suspicious man in black appearing in the place where the demons gather, and quietly observed his actions.
lg_TaskTalk100140: <font color='#00b034'>Pakkun </font>learned that the demons are being ordered by a man in black to attack the villagers. We will uncover many secrets if we capture that man.
lg_TaskTalk100141: Defeat the man in black, and his control over the demons will vanish. People will be able to live here safely.
lg_TaskTalk100150:
Hm, what is this face mask? Could the man in black have dropped it? Why does Pakkun find this scent familiar... but I can't recall for the life of me.
Why don't you ask the master, maybe she knows the origin of this mask.
lg_TaskTalk100151: He is the prodigy of the<font color='#00b034'> Wind Village</font>, the one who always seized the top position in every trial. The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>respected him greatly and sent him to<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>for special training. Soon after, he left<font color='#00b034'> Angel City </font>and vanished, and now we find that he is the mastermind behind all the demon chaos.
lg_TaskTalk100160: I think he is the mastermind behind the demons' evil deeds. This must be reported to the<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder</font>, you must return to the village now.
lg_TaskTalk100161: Regarding this, I will send someone to investigate. I will let him keep walking the path of sin.
lg_TaskTalk100170:
You have completed this quest. Now it's time for you to learn something.
Relax, and listen to me patiently.
lg_TaskTalk100171: He was one of the ninja sent to<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>. I don't want him to give in to the temptation of darkness.
lg_TaskTalk100180:
It's time to head to Angel City for another selection of elite ninja. Recently, in the Eventide Barrens, Potato Demons have been stealing crops from the villagers. To protect the winter harvest, this must be resolved.
If you can get rid of the thieving Potato Demons, you will pass the trial and qualify to take part in the training in Angel City. Of course, Potato Demons are not like the monsters you've defeated so far, so don't rush in unless you're sure you can win.
lg_TaskTalk100181: Excellent, you have proven your courage through your actions. Congratulations on passing the trial. There is still some time before you leave for<font color='#00b034'> Angel City</font>. I hope you will continue your training during this period, and become the best at facing your future challenges!
lg_TaskTalk100190: Ah yes, the<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>seems to be having some trouble, why don't you help him when you're free.
lg_TaskTalk100191: The<font color='#00b034'> Village Elder </font>asked you to come, that's great. I was at a loss as to whom to ask for help.
lg_TaskTalk100200: It's like this: the supplier regularly sends a<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant</font>, but it has been several days past the last scheduled delivery and the<font color='#00b034'> Traveling Merchant </font>still hasn't arrived. I'm worried he ran into trouble on the way. Could you go out and see if he's all right?
lg_TaskTalk100201: The<font color='#00b034'> Merchant Boss </font>asked for your help? That's great! Help me teach those damn monkeys a lesson.
lg_TaskTalk100210: The<font color='#00b034'> Monkeys </font>nearby stole my straw hat while I was resting. If I weren't watching the rest of my goods, I would teach them a lesson myself. Since you're here, please help me get my straw hat back from them.
lg_TaskTalk100211: The stolen straw hat has been retrieved. I must hurry to the<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village </font>to deliver the goods. If I miss the deadline, I'll have to pay heavy compensation.
lg_TaskTalk100220: The world is in chaos right now. The whole country is troubled by demons and evil creatures. I just heard that the<font color='#00b034'> Smelting Mountains </font>are occupied by a group of<font color='#00b034'> Scarlet </font>bandits. If my goods are robbed by them, my business will go bankrupt. Can you deal with the bandits and escort me to the<font color='#00b034'> Fire Village </font>at the same time?

lg_TaskTalk900031: Now it's time for combat training! Go to the <font color='#00b034'>Smelting Mountains</font> and talk to the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font>. He will arrange your training. Do your best!
lg_TaskTalk900040: A sunny day. First, you need to know how to fight. There is a creature called a <font color='#ff0000'>Sunflower</font>. Go and kill it. I will check your work!
lg_TaskTalk900041: Mmmm! For a beginner, you're not bad. I've waited a long time for a talent like you. Keep doing your best! Now return to the Village. The Village Elder will give you your next instructions.
lg_TaskTalk900050: I heard what happened at the Smelting Mountains. Good for you! I will guide you through the next fight. It's in the same place. lg_TaskTalk900051: Awesome! You passed the training! Now I can trust you to complete tasks. You'd better go to the <font color='#00b034'>Smelting Mountains</font>, meet the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font> and thank him for his help. Maybe he has some new quests for you!
lg_TaskTalk900060: Oh, it's you! I hope you can help me... The number of pesky <font color='#ff0000'>Stinger Bees</font> has increased. Can you wipe them out for me? Even killing one would help.
lg_TaskTalk900061: Yes, keep up the good work. The Genin needs your help with another problem. Bon voyage!
lg_TaskTalk900070: You're just in time! The <font color='#ff0000'>Sunflowers</font> are starting to become a nuisance. You must wipe them out to settle it! It's not a heavy job, but never underestimate your enemy.
lg_TaskTalk900071: Smart student! You've completed it. Here is your reward! It will help you in the future.
lg_TaskTalk900080: The <font color='#ff0000'>Healing Pouch</font> is quite helpful. You can use it when you want supplies in the wilds.
lg_TaskTalk900081: How do you feel? Your energy is full again, isn't it?
lg_TaskTalk900090: Don't celebrate yet. Now I need detailed information about the <font color='#00b034'>Smelting Mountains</font>, which has been recorded by the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font>. All you need to do is bring those notes back.
lg_TaskTalk900091: I have information on this, but I have to organize it first.
lg_TaskTalk900100: The information you need is very simple. But I will arrange your memory notes so that you can't take this information with you. Do you remember it all? If so, you may go now.
lg_TaskTalk900101: Judging by what you just told me, the situation there isn't bad. But still, we can't lower our guard!
lg_TaskTalk900110: The next mission is to find something for my research into a new formula. Meet the <font color='#00b034'>Genin</font> at the <font color='#00b034'>Smelting Mountains</font> to learn about all that. You can meet him for the full details.
lg_TaskTalk900111: I need to think about it carefully. You can rest now.
